content.comment_body: Hello, I'm experiencing issues getting my analog slider and push buttons to function correctly from [product_name] Web Editor to [product_name] Soft Comfort. I'm trying to simulate a network analog input pressure value using the analog slider. One push button should activate a pump until the simulated pressure reaches a set threshold (from the analog slider), while the other serves as an emergency stop. When I use either push button, the analog slider moves as well, and my program isn't reading the slider value properly during manual adjustment. Thanks,
It looks like there is an overlap in the virtual memory area. Bits V0.1 and V0.2 are part of the word VW0. VB0 includes V0.0 to V0.7 VB1 includes V1.0 to V1.7 VW0 = VB0 + VB1 = V0.0 to V1.7

analysis.insight_summary: The user describes inconsistent behavior when using the analog slider and push buttons, aiming to simulate analog input and pump control logic. The program fails to read the analog value correctly during manual adjustments if both controls are operated, likely due to overlapping variable addresses in memory, as suggested by a follow-up comment.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is seeking reliable and independent operation of the analog slider and push buttons. They expect simultaneous manual adjustments to be accurately reflected by the program for effective simulation and testing.
